scope: Passive PC traces of five public G4BENCH workloads in the exact original OF816 package, idle and visible counter; three measured batches per workload.

profile.scope: Three measured batches per row; warmup/clear/calibration/report excluded. Exclusive CPU includes bus stalls and kernel work; interrupts and other Tasks are separate. Inclusive routine totals overlap. Completion polling is software polling time, not exact DMA occupancy.
